datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Malawi administrative units during 2011. The data represents spatial classifications of acute food insecurity phases derived from the Integrated Food Security Phase Classification methodology, reflecting population-level food security impacts.
